# GPT-3

GPT-3 is a 175B-parameter decoder-only [[transformer]] language model
released by OpenAI in 2020. It was the largest publicly known model at
release and demonstrated few-shot learning at scale.

The model was an early validation of the [[scaling-laws]] argument: a
much larger model trained on more data without architectural changes
produced qualitatively new capabilities (in-context learning, prompting,
chain-of-thought).

Sources: [[scaling-laws-paper]].
